audience: agencies and consultancies that run clients, time, expenses and invoices in Moxie

useCases.title: Find open invoices for a client
useCases.text: List the outstanding invoices, or the invoices of one client by its exact name. Search clients to find the exact name.

useCases.title: Review time logged on client projects
useCases.text: Find a project by name. List completed time entries in a time window, filtered by user, client or project. Each call returns up to 10,000 entries.

useCases.title: Read private project notes
useCases.text: Find a project by name. Read its private workspace notes, newest first.

useCases.title: Add or update a project note
useCases.text: Add a private note to a project. Update a note to replace its body. An update does not add text to the existing body.

useCases.title: Record a billable expense for a client
useCases.text: Find the client. Record an expense, billable to the client with a markup if needed.

useCases.title: Track sales opportunities
useCases.text: Search the pipeline by text, client, stage or status. Create a sales opportunity when a new lead comes in.
